summary.title: CGM dominant filter production-shaped diagnostic repeated board summary
summary.label: cgm_phase010_dominant_filter_repeated

metadata.dataset: synthetic CGM diagnostic workloads; case label defines exact input shape

comparisons.name: filter_dominant_320x240

baseline.label: Std build
baseline.checksum_policy: FNV-style checksum over filtered one-hot uint8_t map
baseline.timer_boundary: filterQuantizedGradientsCandidate, 3x3 dominant-bin count plus >=5 threshold for inner pixels
baseline.gate: organized uint8_t quantized map values 0..8, width>=3, height>=3, borders are zero-filled
baseline.mask: 3x3 bin equality masks for directions 1..8; zero bin participates only as non-direction background
baseline.reduction: lane-wise 9-neighbor equality count per direction; strict greater-than preserves production tie-break
baseline.asm_boundary: filterQuantizedGradientsCandidate / inlined RVV byte compare and store in bench_cgm_rvv
